AboutPage.title: About Al-Adl
AboutPage.description: We are a premier law firm in the Sultanate of Oman, dedicated to providing exceptional legal services with integrity, professionalism, and a client-centric approach. Our team of experienced lawyers specializes in various fields of law to ensure the best representation for our clients.
AboutPage.missionText: To provide justice through expert legal representation and honest consultancy.
AboutPage.visionText: To be the leading law firm in the region, known for excellence and ethical standards.
AboutPage.heroSubtitle: Leading the way in legal excellence across the Sultanate. We provide strategic counsel and dedicated advocacy for modern legal challenges.
AboutPage.legacyText: Our firm was established with a singular vision: to bridge the gap between complex legal frameworks and practical, results-driven solutions. Today, we stand as one of the most trusted names in Omani law.
AboutPage.valuesText: Integrity, Transparency, and Professionalism are the pillars of every case we handle.
AboutPage.ctaSubtitle: Our attorneys are ready to provide the professional counsel you need. Schedule a consultation today.

PrivacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPolicy.introduction: Al-Adl Law Firm respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data in accordance with Omani Law, specifically Royal Decree 6/2021 (Personal Data Protection Law).
PrivacyPolicy.collectionText: We collect information you provide directly, such as your name, contact details, and case-related information, when you interact with our consultancy forms.
PrivacyPolicy.usageText: Your data is used solely for providing legal services, managing client relationships, and fulfilling our professional duties under the laws of the Sultanate.
PrivacyPolicy.securityText: We implement rigid physical and digital security measures to prevent unauthorized access or disclosure of your confidential legal information.
PrivacyPolicy.rightsText: You have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data, subject to legal and professional retention requirements.
